purpose: Inventory and integrity baseline for browser libraries committed under lib/.

dependencies.name: docx
dependencies.note: Identified by matching, not by reading a version string: the bundle carries none of its own, and the 0.132.0 inside it belongs to @oxc-project/runtime, a build-toolchain dependency. Every docx release in the plausible window had its dist/index.umd.cjs hashed; 9.7.1 differed by 267 bytes and a full diff placed the entire difference in three lines at the top and one at the bottom. The published UMD wrapper has been replaced locally with a plain IIFE assigning 'var docx', so the file is not byte-identical to any published artifact and its hash above will not match upstream. All 33,170 body lines are. When upgrading, take dist/index.umd.cjs from the new release and re-apply the same wrapper swap.
dependencies.localModification: UMD wrapper replaced with an IIFE exposing the global 'docx'

dependencies.name: pdfjs-dist-classic
dependencies.note: Pinned at 3.11.174 because that is the last pdfjs-dist major to publish a classic (non-module) build, and browsers refuse ESM imports across file:// origins. It loads ONLY on file://, and the runtime mitigation for CVE-2024-4367 is isEvalSupported:false, passed at every getDocument() call site. Upgrading this is not a matter of picking a newer version: no newer version exists in a form that can load here without adding a build step.

dependencies.name: pdfjs-dist-esm
dependencies.note: The build served over http(s). pdfjs-dist ships ESM only from 4.x onward — there is no classic build in any 4.x, 5.x or 6.x release, which is why the file:// fallback below is pinned to the last major that had one.
